1950

Logic as mirror

The Turing Test

A question is asked: can machines think?

1956

Formal dream

AI is born

The Dartmouth workshop coins the field of artificial intelligence.

1986

Learning loops

Neural networks rise

Backpropagation gives machines a new way to learn from layered representations.

2012

Scale ignition

Deep learning breakthrough

Image recognition enters a new era with massive data and GPU-scale training.

2017

Context engine

Transformers arrive

Attention becomes the architecture of modern AI, enabling context at unprecedented breadth.

2022

Prompt revolution

Generative AI goes mainstream

LLMs become creative, conversational, and accessible across work, education, and culture.

2026

Action layer

Agentic systems

AI begins planning, using tools, and executing multi-step work in real environments.

2035

Living fabric

Ambient intelligence

AI becomes a seamless layer across work, health, cities, creativity, and daily life.
